div.style: color: rgb(28, 25, 23) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center; width: 340px;

span.p:
OLHOS FALANTES - FLUXO DE DADOS (linha do tempo)
da foto do item ate o feedback falado e escrito ao usuario

div.style: color: rgb(28, 25, 23) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Usuario (dona Lucia)
TalkBack ativo, segura o celular
e aponta a camera para o item

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
1 . ui.ts
Toque no botao grande
'Tirar foto e descrever'

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
2 . a11y.ts + speech.ts
Aviso: 'Vou abrir a camera'
(aria-live + voz)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
3 . camera.ts
Pede permissao, abre a camera traseira
e mostra o preview

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
4 . ui.ts
Toque em 'Capturar' - 1 snapshot
(sem video)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
5 . image.ts
EXIF rotate, redimensiona,
JPEG q0.8, remove metadados
(rejeita acima de ~1.5 MB)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
6 . a11y.ts + speech.ts
Progresso falado e visivel:
'Analisando...'

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
7 . api.ts
POST /api/describe (multipart)
timeout de 20 s

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
8 . main.py
rate limit, valida a imagem,
remove EXIF, injeta o prompt fixo
nao persiste nada

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
9 . vendor.py
Chama a API de visao-linguagem
com o prompt fixo

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
10 . Cloud API
Gera a descricao curta em pt-BR:
objetos, layout, texto visivel

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
11 . main.py
Monta o JSON fixo:
ok, confidence, description,
user_message, retry

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
12 . api.ts + types.ts
Valida e tipa (DescribeResponse)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
13 . ui.ts
Mostra o texto grande e de alto
contraste (fica sempre na tela)

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
14 . a11y.ts
Anuncia 'Descricao pronta'

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
15 . speech.ts
So no gesto 'Ouvir':
speechSynthesis le em pt-BR

div.style: color: rgb(28, 25, 23) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Usuario ouve e/ou le a descricao
pode tocar 'Ouvir' de novo
(descricao nunca fica so no audio)

div.style: color: rgb(28, 25, 23) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Permissao negada (etapa 2)
camera.ts cai no fallback:
'escolher foto'

div.style: color: rgb(28, 25, 23) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Imagem ruim ou escura (etapa 3)
nao envia; pede outra foto

div.style: color: rgb(28, 25, 23) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Sem rede ou timeout 20 s (etapa 4)
api.ts avisa e deixa tentar de novo

div.style: color: rgb(28, 25, 23) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Vendor fora do ar (etapa 6)
JSON ok:false + mensagem amigavel

div.style: color: rgb(28, 25, 23) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 340px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Confianca baixa (etapa 7)
mostra 'Nao sei' em vez de inventar
